describes: packages/plugin/interaction: tools, handler routing, cursor arbitration, touch pre-flight, feedback.

cases.name: defaults
cases.covers: A fresh hub: the pointer tool, the neutral cursor, the two built-in tools in order, and the capability object in literal member order.

cases.name: default-tool-config
cases.covers: config.defaultTool picks the initial tool; the cursor starts neutral whatever the tool.

cases.name: unknown-default-tool
cases.covers: A defaultTool nobody registered still reads back: activeTool() synthesizes a neutral tool with no tags, so no tagged handler is eligible.

cases.name: activate-tool
cases.covers: activateTool refuses an unknown id; otherwise SET_TOOL, a cursor resync (the pan gap cursor off-page), then every tool-change callback in subscription order. Re-activating the same tool still dispatches and notifies; the reducer keeps the state. Unsubscribing answers whether the callback was still subscribed.

cases.name: priority-routing
cases.covers: A down goes to eligible handlers in descending priority; the first to return true owns the gesture, and move and up go only to it. After the up, a move with no owner is hover for every eligible handler, highest first.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: fall-through
cases.covers: A handler that declines the down (falsy answers included) lets the next one try; truthy non-booleans capture. When nobody captures, move is hover and up reaches nobody.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: equal-priority-is-registration-order
cases.covers: Ties keep registration order (the sort is stable), for downs and for hover.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: tool-gating
cases.covers: enabledFor sees the active tool (tags as a set) on every down and hover pass; a handler that answers false is skipped. The built-in text handler shape: pointer enables it, pan does not.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: missing-members
cases.covers: Optional members are optional: an owner without onMove or onUp ignores those phases, and hover skips handlers without onHover.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: cancel
cases.covers: cancel aborts: the owner gets onCancel, or onUp when it has none, or nothing when it has neither; the gesture is released either way, and a cancel with no owner reaches nobody.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: a-new-down-replaces-the-owner
cases.covers: Every down starts over: the previous owner is dropped before the new pass, even when nobody captures it.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: source-filtering
cases.covers: A handler registered with a source only sees samples stamped with that source, or unstamped ones; a handler without a source sees everything. An options object without a source is no scope.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: unregister-mid-gesture
cases.covers: Unregistering the owner releases the gesture: the next move is hover among the remaining handlers and the up reaches nobody. Unregistering again, or a handler that does not own the gesture, is harmless.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: unregister-scoped-handler
cases.covers: Unregistering a source-scoped handler forgets its scope along with it, and only its scope: another scoped handler keeps filtering.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: activate-tool-mid-gesture
cases.covers: Switching tools drops the gesture owner and every hover claim.

cases.name: cursor-claims
cases.covers: The claim stack: the highest priority wins, ties go to the earliest claim, re-claiming a token keeps its place, null releases it, and priority defaults to 0. SET_CURSOR only when the resolved cursor changes.

cases.name: page-edges
cases.covers: The base cursor applies only over a page: crossing a page edge resyncs, staying on the same side does not, and the gap cursor is the tool gapCursor or the neutral arrow.

cases.name: tool-cursor-skins
cases.covers: A skin restyles the winning keyword (claim or base) for its tool only; unmapped keywords, gaps and other tools render as-is; a mapped null falls back; null removes the skin; each change resyncs.

cases.name: register-tool
cases.covers: registerTool adds in order, and replacing an id keeps its place; the unregister deletes by id (and its skin), even a later replacement, and does not touch the active tool, which then reads back as the neutral fallback until another is activated.

cases.name: would-claim-touch
cases.covers: wouldClaimTouch walks eligible handlers in priority order and stops at the first truthy claimsTouch; handlers without it never claim; source and tool gating apply; nothing is captured.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: sample-shape
cases.covers: The sample reaches handlers as given: page context, click count, pointer type, gesture marker, source and the project function.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: tool-lookups
cases.covers: getDefaultToolId, getTool (null for an unknown id), hasTool and activeToolEnables read the registry and the armed tool.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: push-and-pop-tools
cases.covers: pushTool arms a tool over the stack and hands its payload to onToolChanged; popTool restores the previous one, and with an empty stack does nothing. pushTool refuses an unknown id. activateTool clears the stack; activateDefaultTool arms the configured default.

cases.name: register-tool-conflict
cases.covers: A duplicate id is refused with conflict unless replace is set; a replaced registration's remover is inert, and the replacement's remover deletes it.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: gesture-events
cases.covers: onGestureStarted fires for the capturing handler with the page ref and pointer type (mouse when absent); onGestureEnded on up, onGestureCancelled on cancel; a down nobody captures, and an up or cancel with no owner, fire nothing. Over a gap the page is null. onCursorChanged fires on every resolved change.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: feedback-noop
cases.covers: Without a provider the feedback capability is a no-op in literal member order.
cases.reason: Pins gesture routing between handlers, which the handler callbacks record in order. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: feedback-provider
cases.covers: An injected provider is the capability; the plugin is workspace-scoped and stateless.
